attributes.additional_details: The Queen and bees are the best. Especially on coins. The Great British currency will be better with them.
attributes.background: The only positive of the new pound coins is the fact there are bees. Bees are great. If the pound coin had bees and Queen Elizabeth II on it then we'd be happier and better as a nation, Queen Elizabeth II will forever live on in our hearts and in our coins. So will bees. We want the Queen back.
